# 2026.331.0307 — chore(pins): advance the wave that pins the reasonix-free corpus

## Summary

Gitlink sync: every umbrella submodule pin advanced to what **the pin contract** requires
— `charly` to its own default-branch HEAD, `distro-*` to exactly the commits charly's
own gitlinks pin, everything else to its own default branch.

**The headline leg is `marketplace`** (`e306b10` → `02c5cee`): the corpus regenerated by opencharly/marketplace#662 and #663 after the reasonix retirement (opencharly/opencharly#1302), so the umbrella now pins a corpus with no live reasonix projection. The same advance retires 55 corpus skills (measured 2026-11-27), so 58 `.dsh/skills` links disappear and 3 new ones appear; every one is the derivation following the new corpus. Three gate findings from that corpus are fixed here too: `.pi/settings.json`'s marketplace package pin advances to the corpus tag `v2026.331.0144`; the dispatcher-coverage ratchet tightens to the measured `174` (297 skills, 123 routed), so its self-test arm discriminates again; and the pin-tag census lowers its stale `layer-cdi` row (the new pin is a CHANGELOG tip).

**42** gitlink(s) and **6** non-gitlink changed path(s) moved, and **58** path(s) removed. Every changed path is
named in the complete per-pin evidence table below (no elision) — a moved path
with its proof, a removed path with the fact that this diff deletes it.

## Every changed path, named

The **`106`** changed paths are named in full — each moved gitlink with its
`staged-gitlink` vs remote default-branch `HEAD` proof, each moved non-gitlink path with its
staged blob, each removed path with the fact that this diff deletes it — in the complete
per-pin evidence table in **How tested** below. That one table IS the changed-path list
and the evidence: no separate list is emitted and no row is elided, so nothing points
at a file for evidence that must be pasted here.

Each gitlink entry is a **submodule pointer**, not file content: the umbrella records which
commit of each repo the snapshot means. The content behind every gitlink was reviewed and
gated by that repo's own `pr-validator` before it was tagged. A non-gitlink path, when
present, is an ordinary changed file carried on this same branch — named, not hidden.
A removed path, when present, is a path this diff DELETES — named with that fact, and
never compared against a remote it has no staged pin for.
This PR cannot review submodule content and does not restate it.

**Default-branch HEAD, per moved pin.** Every moved path, complete (no
elision): the STAGED GITLINK this PR records (`git ls-files -s` from the index,
`git ls-tree HEAD` fallback) beside the owning
remote default-branch HEAD (`git ls-remote <url> HEAD`, read when THIS table is
generated). `charly` and every non-`distro-*` pin is the owning repo's
default-branch HEAD **as of the walk that produced this diff**; a `distro-*` pin
tracks charly's own gitlink and is proven by the pin check, so it is edge-pinned
rather than required equal here:

```
legend: <path>  <staged-gitlink>  <remote-HEAD>  <flag>
        (= equal · ! NOT equal at table-generation time; distro-* = edge-pinned)
        A walk resolves each remote HEAD when it runs; this table compares at the
        moment it is generated — later. A `!` on a non-`distro-*` row therefore has
        two readings, told apart by the two commits themselves:
        (a) THE SYNC RACE — the owning default branch advanced after the walk, so the
            staged pin is an ANCESTOR of the remote HEAD
            (`git -C <submodule> merge-base --is-ancestor <staged> <remote-HEAD>` →
            true); benign — the body discloses it by name and never chases it.
        (b) A REAL FINDING — the staged pin is not on that repo default branch at all
            (a PR branch, or a non-HEAD commit); that ancestor check is false.
        A `distro-*` row is neither: it tracks the gitlink charly records, which
        the pin check proves.
        (a non-gitlink changed path is rendered `  <path>  <blob>  (file)` — a
        plain file has no remote default-branch HEAD to compare, so it carries no flag;
        its blob is the index blob this PR stages and is never `!`-flagged.)
        (a path this diff REMOVES is rendered `  <path>  (removed)` — it is in HEAD
        or in the base the branch left, and in neither the index nor HEAD when the body
        renders a pushed branch, so a deletion is never counted as a moved file); the old
        but no longer in the index, so this PR records no pin and no blob for it:
        there is nothing to compare, and it is never `=`/`!`-flagged.)
```
